compound_name: Fe(II) porphyrin (unsubstituted model system, D4h geometry)
geometry_source: optimized triplet geometry from their Ref 82 (same geometry as the HCISCF study they compare against)
method: ASCI-SCF (selected-CI approximation to CASSCF for large active spaces) + extrapolated ASCI+PT2
active_space_orbital_description: 24 porphyrin pi orbitals + Fe 3d, 4s, 4p, 4d complete shells + 4 N sigma lone pairs coordinating Fe
active_space_protocol: (32,29) 5 Fe 3d + 24 porphyrin pi; (44,44) additionally Fe 4d (double-shell), Fe 4px/4py, eight N 2px/2py — found unbalanced (odd subset of C-N sigma/sigma* enters, orbital optimization pushes weakly-correlated orbitals like 4d(x2-y2) out, symmetry breaking, local extrema); final balanced (40,42) = 24 pi + Fe 3d/4s/4p/4d + 4 N sigma lone pairs (drops non-coordinating N 2p, adds Fe 4s/4pz to complete shells) — preserved orbital symmetry, no orbital slipping
Other: PT2 correction critical for state ordering: at variational ASCI-SCF level 5A1g is lowest, triplet ground state only after +PT2. Unbalanced (44e,44o) space gave quintet ground with ~19 kcal/mol quintet-triplet gap; paper argues the earlier HCISCF triplet result for (44e,44o) (their Ref 40) is a local extremum. NOONs show little multireference character in all four states. States are state-specific orbital-optimized (not state-averaged); 3B2g etc. collapsed during orbital optimization
reference_short: Levine, Hait, Tubman, Lehtola, Whaley, Head-Gordon, J. Chem. Theory Comput. (2020)

Experimental ground state is triplet (their Refs 74-76), consistent with the (40,42) result. Paper's NiC (22e,89o) CASCI benchmark skipped: full-valence convergence test, no state ordering

compound_name: (C3N2H5)CuO2 — side-on Cu-O2 with truncated 1,3-diketiminate model ligand (LCuO2)
geometry_source: B3LYP-DFT optimized (Stuttgart PP + basis on Cu, 6-31G(d) others); lowest singlet and triplet structures separately
relativistic_treatment: DKH2 (second-order Douglas-Kroll-Hess, used with BS2; all calcs on this compound used BS2)
active_space_orbital_description: all Cu 3d,4d + O 2p,3p except one O 3p (corresponding to unoccupied sigma_y* of O2^2-); RAS2 subspace (8,6) = Cu 3dxy / O 2px,y bonding-antibonding combinations + O 2pz pi*(a2)
active_space_protocol: (8,6) minimal: Cu 3dxy-O 2px,y combinations + O 2pz pi*(a2); (16,15) adds Cu 3d double-shell (4d), drops O 3p and non-bonding doubly-occupied O 2pz pi(b2); (18,21) full valence Cu 3d,4d + O 2p,3p minus sigma_y* O 3p. RAS1->RAS3 excitation level n=2-4; up to quadruples mandatory for Cu-O bond correlation
Other: Cu 3d double-shell effect shifts CASPT2 Delta_EST by >10 kcal/mol between (8in6) and (16in15) reference; adding O 2p-3p correlation ((16,15)->(18,21)) shifts another 2.5-3.5 kcal/mol; authors' converged estimate 11.2-11.5 kcal/mol favoring singlet
reference_short: Malmqvist, Pierloot, Shahi, Cramer, Gagliardi, J. Chem. Phys. 128, 204109 (2008)

geometry_source: structures taken from their Ref 49 (same as prior DFT/CR-CC study, results directly comparable)
basis_set: BS1: Stuttgart PP + basis on Cu, ANO-L [4s3p2d] O/N, [2s1p] H; some results with BS2: ANO-RCC (see -a row)
relativistic_treatment: DKH2 for BS2 results; BS1 results without (Stuttgart PP on Cu)
active_space_orbital_description: all valence electrons from occupied Cu 3d and O 2p in all valence orbitals + one correlating orbital each (Cu 3d,4d + O 2p,3p); RAS2 left empty (all in RAS1/RAS3) except (8in6) variants
active_space_protocol: (8,6) minimal: bonding/antibonding combinations of both Cu 3dxy + O 2px,y; (24,24) adds Cu 4d double-shell + remaining Cu 3d, O 2p and correlating orbitals minus O 2pz,3pz and O 3px,y; (24,28) adds back O 3px,y; (28,32) full: Cu 3d,4d + O 2p,3p. RAS1->RAS3 excitation levels n=2-5; authors judge total active-space size converged at (28,32)
Other: Delta_Ebp = E(bis(mu-oxo)) - E(peroxo), kcal/mol: best BS1 RASPT2(28in32)//4 = -0.7 (no Cu 3s3p corr.) / -0.4 (with); BS2 RASPT2(24in28)//4 = -2.6, (28in32)//4 = -3.3; CASPT2(8in6) BS2 = -26.2 (severely overestimates bis(mu-oxo) stability). Authors: impossible to converge this equilibrium with plain CASPT2 active spaces; Cu 3s,3p semicore correlation effect ~3 kcal/mol at CASPT2(8in6) but shrinks with larger active spaces
